# package ontology

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/ontology"
```

Package ontology exposes a namespace profile as a small, typed concept graph: logical node classes contain data objects, data objects use CDCs, CDCs contain attributes, attributes have types, definitions belong to namespaces, and — with semantic mapping enabled — measurements represent quantities, belong to phases and are measured by data objects.

	g, err := ontology.BuildGraph(profile, ontology.Options{Semantics: semantic.Default})
	for _, r := range g.Relations(ontology.LogicalNodeID("MMXU"), ontology.Contains) { ... }
	err = g.ExportJSON(os.Stdout)

The graph is deterministic: listings, traversals and the JSON export are ordered, so identical input gives byte-identical output. It uses no RDF, OWL or CIM libraries.

#### Adapter seam {#hdr-Adapter_seam}

Measurement, quantity, phase and reference concepts are protocol-neutral. They are expected to move to a shared OTFabric ontology module used by Modbus, SunSpec, DNP3 and OPC UA mappings as well; this package will then link IEC 61850 concepts to that module instead of defining them. Concept IDs of the semantic kinds ("quantity:voltage", "phase:A") are chosen to stay stable across that move.

## Types

### type Concept

```go
type Concept struct {
	// ID is unique in the graph, e.g. "ln:MMXU", "do:MMXU.Hz",
	// "cdc:MV", "quantity:frequency".
	ID   string `json:"id"`
	Kind Kind   `json:"kind"`
	// Name is the element name, e.g. "Hz".
	Name string `json:"name"`
	// Label is a human-readable label, when one is known.
	Label string `json:"label,omitempty"`
	// Namespace is the defining namespace of model concepts.
	Namespace model.NamespaceID `json:"namespace,omitzero"`
	// Properties carry further facts, e.g. presence, FC, rule.
	Properties []Property `json:"properties,omitempty"`
}
```

### type Graph

```go
type Graph struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

Graph is an immutable concept graph. Every listing and traversal is deterministic. It is safe for concurrent use.

#### func BuildGraph

```go
func BuildGraph(p *catalog.Profile, opts Options) (*Graph, error)
```

BuildGraph builds the concept graph of a profile: namespaces and their dependencies; logical node classes with inheritance and data objects; CDCs with sub data objects and data attributes; constructed types with members; enumerations and basic types. With Options.Semantics, measurements are added for every mapped data object and phase, linked to quantities, phases and references.

Relations whose target is not defined in the profile are left out; [catalog.Profile.Diagnostics](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/catalog#Profile.Diagnostics) reports such references. Names defined by more than one namespace keep their first definition and are listed by [Graph.Conflicts](#func-graph-conflicts).

#### func (Graph) Concept

```go
func (g *Graph) Concept(id string) (Concept, bool)
```

Concept returns the concept with the given ID.

#### func (Graph) Concepts

```go
func (g *Graph) Concepts() []Concept
```

Concepts returns all concepts, ordered by ID.

#### func (Graph) Conflicts

```go
func (g *Graph) Conflicts() []string
```

Conflicts lists the concepts that more than one namespace of the profile defines, and classes whose measurements could not be mapped because a name is ambiguous. The graph keeps the first definition in namespace order; [catalog.Profile.Diagnostics](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/catalog#Profile.Diagnostics) reports the same conflicts.

#### func (Graph) ExportJSON

```go
func (g *Graph) ExportJSON(w io.Writer) error
```

ExportJSON writes the indented JSON form of the graph to w. The output is byte-identical for identical input.

#### func (Graph) FindConcepts

```go
func (g *Graph) FindConcepts(q Query) []Concept
```

FindConcepts returns the concepts matching q, ordered by ID.

#### func (Graph) Incoming

```go
func (g *Graph) Incoming(id string, preds ...Predicate) []Relation
```

Incoming returns the incoming relations of a concept, restricted to the given predicates when any are given, ordered by predicate and source.

#### func (Graph) MarshalJSON

```go
func (g *Graph) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error)
```

MarshalJSON encodes the graph as {"concepts": \[...], "relations": \[...]}, both in their deterministic order.

#### func (Graph) Relations

```go
func (g *Graph) Relations(id string, preds ...Predicate) []Relation
```

Relations returns the outgoing relations of a concept, restricted to the given predicates when any are given, ordered by predicate and target.

#### func (Graph) RelationsAll

```go
func (g *Graph) RelationsAll() []Relation
```

RelationsAll returns all relations, ordered by source, predicate and target.

#### func (Graph) Walk

```go
func (g *Graph) Walk(start string, fn func(c Concept, depth int) bool, preds ...Predicate) error
```

Walk traverses the graph breadth-first from start along outgoing relations with the given predicates (all when none are given), visiting each concept once. fn receives the concept and its distance from start; returning false stops the walk below that concept. Neighbors are visited in [Graph.Relations](#func-graph-relations) order.

### type Kind

```go
type Kind string
```

Kind is the kind of a concept.

```go
const (
	KindNamespace            Kind = "namespace"
	KindLogicalNode          Kind = "logical-node-class"
	KindDataObject           Kind = "data-object"
	KindCDC                  Kind = "cdc"
	KindSubDataObject        Kind = "sub-data-object"
	KindDataAttribute        Kind = "data-attribute"
	KindConstructedAttribute Kind = "constructed-attribute"
	KindEnumeration          Kind = "enumeration"
	KindBasicType            Kind = "basic-type"
	KindMeasurement          Kind = "measurement"
	KindQuantity             Kind = "quantity"
	KindPhase                Kind = "phase"
	KindReference            Kind = "reference"
)
```

Concept kinds. The model kinds mirror IEC 61850 definitions; the semantic kinds (measurement, quantity, phase, reference) are protocol-neutral OTFabric concepts.

### type Options

```go
type Options struct {
	// Semantics adds measurement concepts, with their quantities,
	// phases and references, using this mapper. Nil leaves them out.
	Semantics *semantic.Mapper
}
```

Options configures [BuildGraph](#func-buildgraph).

### type Predicate

```go
type Predicate string
```

Predicate is the kind of a relation.

```go
const (
	// Contains: a class contains a data object, a CDC a sub data object
	// or data attribute, a constructed type a member.
	Contains Predicate = "contains"
	// Uses: a data object or sub data object uses a CDC.
	Uses Predicate = "uses"
	// HasType: an attribute has a basic, constructed or enumerated
	// type; a data object has an underlying type.
	HasType Predicate = "hasType"
	// InheritsFrom: a class inherits from a base class, an enumeration
	// extends another.
	InheritsFrom Predicate = "inheritsFrom"
	// DefinedIn: a definition belongs to a namespace.
	DefinedIn Predicate = "definedIn"
	// DependsOn: a namespace depends on another.
	DependsOn Predicate = "dependsOn"
	// Represents: a measurement represents a quantity.
	Represents Predicate = "represents"
	// HasPhase: a measurement belongs to a phase.
	HasPhase Predicate = "hasPhase"
	// HasReference: a voltage measurement has a reference.
	HasReference Predicate = "hasReference"
	// MeasuredBy: a measurement is carried by a data object or sub data
	// object.
	MeasuredBy Predicate = "measuredBy"
)
```

Relation predicates.

### type Query

```go
type Query struct {
	Kinds []Kind
	// Name matches the concept name case-insensitively as a substring,
	// or exactly when Exact is set.
	Name  string
	Exact bool
	// Standard restricts the result to concepts of one standard, e.g.
	// "IEC 61850-7-4".
	Standard string
}
```

Query selects concepts in [Graph.FindConcepts](#func-graph-findconcepts). Empty fields do not filter.
